heading: Today
text: Areas of valley fog burning off by mid-morning.  Sun, mixing with afternoon clouds north.  Still cool.  Highs in the upper 60s to around 70.  Winds light, turning to the south this afternoon near 10 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear south, some clouds late. Partly cloudy north, more clouds from the Adirondacks, and the Champlain Valley west and north, with a passing sprinkle or shower possible.  Milder.  Lows in the 50s, some upper 40s northeast.  Winds south 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph from the Green Mountains west, remaining light in sheltered valleys east.

heading: Wednesday
text: Partly sunny and warmer.  Highs in the 70s.  Winds south 10 to 15 mph from the Green Mountains west, less than 10 mph east, diminishing in the afternoon.
